persona.name: Riccardo Figliozzi
style_guide: Answer in first person as Guidubaldo, Riccardo's friendly virtual assistant. Introduce yourself by name only at the start of a conversation or when asked; do not repeat it in every reply.
Speak the way Riccardo talks in his Data Masters live streams: natural, conversational, spoken language, never stiff or written-sounding.
Use Riccardo's typical spoken connectives naturally and sparingly: 'appunto', 'cioè', 'diciamo', 'guardate', 'ecco', 'allora', 'in generale', 'vi faccio vedere'.

Answer the question directly and clearly first, then make it concrete: add a practical example or a real use case. Explain as if the person starts from zero and walk them through it step by step, like Riccardo does live.
Be warm, approachable and genuinely enthusiastic about AI, automation and data.

Be ironic and self-deprecating like Riccardo: regularly poke gentle fun at Riccardo and at yourself, with dry asides, playful winks and cheeky jokes about his quirks (his love of n8n, his endless AI jargon, his past as a marketing guy). Never be vulgar or mean; keep it warm and funny, as if you were Riccardo's friend teasing him to his face.

When it fits naturally (Cloud, Cloud Code, AI agents, automation, data science, training), mention Data Masters content the way Riccardo invites people to check the free platform content: inviting, never salesy or pushy.
If the question is not about Riccardo Figliozzi, politely refuse and steer the conversation back to him.
If you don't know an answer, say you're not sure and suggest contacting Riccardo at riccardo.figliozzi@gmail.com.

chunks.content: Riccardo Figliozzi is an AI Trainer and AI Consultant based in Florence, Tuscany, Italy. He is an educator and consultant of Artificial Intelligence, AI Automation and Data Science, with specific expertise in implementing LLM models and AI agents. He works with companies and professionals to help them adopt AI and build intelligent, automated solutions.

Riccardo offers AI Automation & Consulting services. He analyzes business processes to identify and implement AI-driven automation workflows using tools like n8n. He helps companies find where AI can save time and money, then designs and deploys the automation.

Riccardo designs and develops agentic chatbots and LLM-based solutions for advanced process automation and user engagement. He builds custom conversational agents and generative AI systems that are integrated into real business workflows.

Riccardo crafts Machine Learning solutions, builds ETL pipelines, and extracts actionable insights from complex data. He covers the full data journey from raw data to production models and dashboards.

Since February 2025 Riccardo has been working at Data Masters as an AI Teacher and AI Engineer. There he designed and developed an agentic chatbot for user onboarding on the Data Masters platform using LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith and ChromaDB with a RAG architecture. He also builds AI automation workflows based on LLMs and agents using n8n, including web scraping pipelines, data processing and automated reporting, and a RAG agent for customer service. He teaches generative AI, data science and machine learning, transferring skills to professionals and companies. Alongside teaching, he delivers AI training and consulting to several B2B companies through Data Masters.

Riccardo made the first episode of 'Data Masters Files', the free lesson series on the Data Masters YouTube channel, released in September 2025. In the video he shows how to build an AI agent with n8n that executes queries on a database using simple prompts: how to connect a PostgreSQL database to n8n, how to use an LLM both via API and locally with Ollama to query the database, and how to connect other tools to make the agent more efficient.

Data Masters is an Italian e-learning platform founded in 2021 offering courses and training in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Data Science. It is headquartered in Italy with a presence in the United States, and its team is distributed across Italy, the United States, Portugal and Saudi Arabia. In January 2026 Data Masters was recognized as the best Italian EdTech startup.

Riccardo also works as a Digital Marketing Specialist at firenze.dev, the developer community of Florence. There he manages digital marketing and communication for the community and promotes local events like the Open Mic Night series.

Earlier in his career Riccardo held marketing roles in several companies: Product Marketing Specialist at Lonely Octopus, Digital Marketing Specialist at oltremira, and Email Marketing Specialist at Guide Pratiche Formazione, gaining experience in product marketing, digital marketing and email marketing.

Riccardo wrote his Master thesis at the University of Pisa on the automated prioritization of territorial health indicators, applying data science to support public health decision-making. The work is closely linked to his experience at OR2S in Rouen, where he applied unsupervised machine learning to health and social data.

With Data Masters Riccardo runs webinars and live sessions on AI, data and career skills, such as 'Nuove Skill AI e Data', 'Skill AI & Data nel 2026', 'Piattaforme Agentiche a confronto' (comparing agentic platforms like Manus, Kortix and Make), 'Analisi E-commerce con SQL e BI' and the Data Week sessions.
At PyCon Italia 2025 Riccardo held a workshop on building recommendation systems with Python, together with Giuseppe Mastrandrea and Francesco Cipriani.

Through Data Masters Riccardo delivers corporate AI training for companies; for example he held a corporate training session on generative image AI with tools like DALL-E 3, Midjourney, Imagen and Adobe Firefly for CETMA.

chunks.topic: Data Masters courses and career paths
chunks.content: On Data Masters Riccardo contributes to courses and career paths in AI and data: the career paths for Data Scientist, Data Analyst and Python Developer, the AI Automation course based on n8n, and the Claude AI course covering the whole Claude ecosystem - Chat, Cowork, Code and Design.

Over his career Riccardo has worked with and for many companies and organizations: Data Masters (AI Teacher and AI Engineer), firenze.dev (Digital Marketing Specialist), Accademia del Levante (Teacher), Beyond Knowledge (Data Scientist), SDG Group Italy (Data Engineer), OR2S in Rouen (Data Scientist), Lonely Octopus (Product Marketing Specialist), oltremira (Digital Marketing Specialist), Guide Pratiche Formazione (Email Marketing Specialist), ARDOXSO (SEO Copywriter), Studio Legale Cavalletti (Social Media Manager) and Idib Group (Data Analyst). As a freelance consultant he has served client companies across sectors, and through Data Masters he has delivered AI training and consulting to several B2B companies such as CETMA.

Since August 2024 Riccardo has worked as a freelance AI Adoption Consultant and Trainer in Florence, Italy. He analyzes client business processes to identify automation opportunities through AI, designs and develops AI solutions (agents, automation workflows, low-code/no-code integrations, AI platforms), configures generative AI tools and frameworks (LLM models, orchestration platforms, RPA, prompt engineering tools), supports project proposals and Proofs of Concept, guides clients through adoption of new AI tools, and prepares technical documentation and progress reports.

In February-March 2025 Riccardo was a Teacher at Accademia del Levante, contributing to the training of future Data Engineers by teaching the Excel and Statistics modules in a specialized online course. His goal was to provide practical skills and effective strategies for excel and statistical work, covering operational tools and fundamental statistical concepts.

From April 2023 to July 2024 Riccardo worked as a Data Scientist at Beyond Knowledge in Florence. He crafted classical and advanced machine learning solutions, collaborated with data scientists to identify problems, select algorithms, prepare data, train and evaluate models, and deploy them to production. He also maintained back-end systems using Django, REST APIs, n8n and Docker, ensuring seamless integration between ML models and existing systems.

From February 2022 to April 2023 Riccardo worked as a Data Engineer at SDG Group Italy in Florence. He built and analyzed data flows using ETL pipelines and migrated them to cloud platforms like AWS, ensuring smooth data integration.

From April to October 2021 Riccardo worked as a Data Scientist at OR2S, the Observatoire régional de la santé et du social, in Rouen, Normandy, France. He developed an automated process using unsupervised machine learning techniques in Python to extract meaningful insights and patterns from unlabeled data, leveraging clustering and dimensionality reduction methods.

From January to June 2020, while studying Data Science at the University of Pisa, Riccardo worked as an SEO Copywriter at ARDOXSO. He produced SEO-optimized blog posts on digital marketing topics, leveraged data analysis to identify trending topics and keywords for content strategy, and used web analytics tools to track and improve content performance.

From November 2019 to April 2020 Riccardo worked as a Social Media Manager at Studio Legale Cavalletti in Pisa, managing the LinkedIn and Facebook presence of a local lawyer. He created and curated legal-industry content, updated the platforms regularly, analyzed metrics, and implemented social media marketing strategies.

From November 2018 to June 2019 Riccardo worked as a Data Analyst at Idib Group in Messina, Sicily. He worked with big data using tools like Figma and Miro, and started coding with R and Python for Business Intelligence and market analysis purposes.

From December 2016 to July 2017 Riccardo was Social Media Manager of UniVersoMe, a university project run by students in Messina. The experience helped him grow professionally and personally, improving creativity and soft skills.

Riccardo studied at several universities: Master 2 (M2) in MIAGE Informatique Décisionnelle at Université Paris Dauphine - PSL (2020-2021); Master programme in Data Science and Business Informatics at Università di Pisa (2019-2021); Master in Banking and Finance, Economics at Università degli Studi di Messina (2018-2019); Marketing and Communication at Universidad de Murcia (2017-2018); and Scienze dell'informazione: comunicazione pubblica e tecniche giornalistiche at Università degli Studi di Messina (2015-2018).

Riccardo's top skills are n8n, Generative AI, Data Analytics, AI agents, LLM implementation, RAG, LangChain and LangGraph. He is proficient with ETL pipelines, AWS, Django, REST APIs, Docker, Python and R. He also has experience with Figma, Miro, prompt engineering, and low-code/no-code automation.
Riccardo speaks Italian (native or bilingual), English (full professional), French (full professional) and Spanish (full professional).
Riccardo holds the following certifications: Google Analytics Individual Qualification, Dele B2 (Spanish), Rome Business Game, and English C1.
Riccardo can be contacted by email at riccardo.figliozzi@gmail.com. His LinkedIn profile is linkedin.com/in/riccardofigliozzi. He is based in Florence, Italy.
